title: Mediocre Candles
text: Mediocre Candles. These candles are pretty mediocre. The scent is. It very strong when burning. The candles looked a bit beat up, too, because the packaging isn’t great. They aren’t awful, but nothing I would replace once they’re gone.

product_metadata.title: Home Traditions Single Wick Evenly Burning Highly Scented Votive Candle, Set of 8 (1.8 Oz Each) for Wedding, Birthday, Holiday, & Home Décor - Aloha Pineapple
features: MOOD LIFTING SCENT - Give yourself up the to sweet and tangy smell of fresh island pineapple
LONG BURN TIME - These single-wick votives measure 2" diameter x 1.5" height and have an incredible burn time - enjoy the scent you love for days on end! Use with votive candle holder.

AROMATHERAPY - Enjoy the delightful aroma throughout your entire room while it burns. Candles are made using the highest concentration of quality fragranced oils that will leave you feeling calm and relaxed.
STRESS RELIEF FOR ANY ROOM - Perfect for your kitchen, bathroom, living room, office, and any other space in need of a delightful highly fragranced scent.
A PERFECT GIFT - Give as a gift or keep for yourself. Makes a great hostess gift, housewarming gift, bridal shower, Christmas gift, teacher appreciation gift, Mother's Day gift and more.
description: Home traditions single wick votive candles are mostly used for décor while giving off a pleasing scent. We suggest that each candle is used with a votive candle holder to prevent accidents. Choose your favorite scent and light it to add ambiance in your home, create a romantic mood, or for aromatherapy. Votive candles make great additions to gift baskets, party favors, or stocking stuffers.
